Each downloaded image was also visually re-checked with the Read tool after running the script. This is still worth a human glance before it ships to real students -- see the chat summary for exactly which file pages were checked.

_sourcing_note_2: The 12 entries below (Primary Upper + Secondary sets) were sourced by Claude on 2026-08-10 with the same process: license + direct URL verified per file via WebFetch, image visually re-checked with Read after downloading. All 12 are public domain or CC0 -- no attribution required for any of them. Visual verification caught two real issues this batch: electric_circuit.jpg first downloaded as solid black due to a script bug (RGBA-with-transparency PNGs need compositing onto a white background before dropping alpha, not just discarding it -- fixed in download_photo_assets.py, all images re-downloaded after the fix); and plate_tectonics.jpg turned out to be a seafloor-spreading cross-section diagram rather than a plain world map, so its prompt/options were rewritten to match what the image actually shows instead of what was originally assumed.
